summary: Backend + Frontend testing for Catatan Kehadiran & Foto Profil Guru features. All 15 pytest backend tests passed (attendance CRUD/upsert/summary/cascade, teacher photo upload/serve/delete via Emergent Managed Object Storage, teacher/students/categories/grades/stats regression). Frontend flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844): Home hero + Catatan Kehadiran shortcut card navigate to /kehadiran; Kehadiran screen shows back button, date navigator (prev/next/today), Kelas 1-6 chip filter, empty state; Settings shows photo avatar + camera badge + Unggah/Ganti/Hapus links, About = 'Rahmat Fadli, M.Pd.,Gr' and Versi 1.0.0; after direct multipart POST /api/teacher/photo the avatar image appears on both Settings and Home hero (testID=teacher-photo); Rekap first column shows H/S/I/A chips (verified H 1·S 1·I 1·A 0) under each student when attendance data exists. No blocking bugs found.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking on native, but consider migrating shadow* → boxShadow (or platform-guard) in shared components (theme/StyleSheet). Reference: any component using shadowOffset/shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on web.

action_items: Optional: Replace legacy shadow* style props with boxShadow (or Platform-specific styles) to remove RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: kehadiran POST accepts any 10-char string as tanggal (len==10 check only). Consider stricter YYYY-MM-DD validation via regex or datetime.strptime for robustness.
server.py: /api/files/{path:path} maps upstream 5xx → 404 which hides transient storage failures from clients; consider surfacing 502 for 5xx to aid debugging.
server.py: attendance summary endpoint has no response_model; typed schema would improve API contract.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed students/attendance/teacher photo and clean up in fixtures / manual DELETE. Teacher profile now has nama='TEST_Guru', nip='1234', mata_pelajaran='IPA'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 15 tests, parallel-safe). Emergent Managed Object Storage works from preview (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL). To test photo upload via web without expo-image-picker, POST multipart directly to /api/teacher/photo.
